package_identity.rule: content-addressed; package_digest is computed from manifest.package_files and recorded in manifest.json and index.json, never inside a hashed package file

artifact_refs.role: author reference implementation; not independent verification

claims.claim_ceiling: ESTABLISHED means only that, under this fixture contract, an authorization is re-evaluated when presented and does not survive expiry, revocation of its signing key, redemption, or a change of the observation, policy bundle or tool definition it was issued under.

assumptions: timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 and the window is [issued_at, expires_at)
`revoked_kids` at a presentation is the revocation state the enforcement point can see at that moment
a grant decision other than `accept` is never an execution authorization
explicit_non_claims: that the clock at the enforcement point is trustworthy
that revocation propagates to every enforcement point in bounded time
that every execution path passes through the enforcement point
a second implementation is by itself an independent verification record
temporal_scope: Pinned fixture evaluation only; no live deployment time window is established.
